catalog_kinds.purpose: versioned local synthetic spacecraft-database metadata without spacecraft connectivity
versioned local synthetic ground-database mappings without a GCS route
immutable procedure library identity and metadata
versioned local memory-map definitions used only by bounded local data services

catalog_identity.immutability_rule: catalog_id plus revision names exactly one immutable canonical content digest
catalog_identity.revision_rule: revisions are positive monotonic integers; published revisions are never overwritten
catalog_identity.lookup_rule: display labels and filesystem names never substitute for catalog_id and revision

path_rules: The URI is parsed structurally and is never joined as a host filesystem path.
Every identifier is an already-decoded bounded NFC segment using the allowlist [A-Za-z0-9._-].
Empty, dot, dot-dot, percent-encoded, slash, backslash, drive-letter, UNC, NUL, control, and case-ambiguous segments are rejected.
Resolution is confined to the durable catalog repository and cannot follow symlinks or reparse points.

legacy_uri_mappings.mapping: parse the authority as the first bounded logical segment and map the remaining path into a pinned spell+local catalog entry identity
parse the authority as the first bounded logical segment and map the remaining path into a pinned spell+local catalog entry identity

legacy_uri_rules: mmd and usr are compatibility syntax tokens, not registered network protocols and never invoke DNS, sockets, URL handlers, mounts, or host filesystem access.
Scheme matching is exact lowercase; userinfo, port, query, fragment, percent encoding, empty segments, traversal, backslash, control bytes, and non-allowlisted characters are rejected.
A legacy URI resolves only when authorization supplies one exact immutable local catalog identity; there is no latest-revision or display-name fallback.

dependency_identity.closure_digest: SHA-256 over the ordered immutable node and edge identities

resolution_transaction: Parse and canonicalize every local URI before repository access.
Resolve the complete immutable dependency closure under one repeatable committed view.
Verify every schema version, revision, content digest, closure bound, and authorization scope.
Publish one resolved closure identity only after the entire graph succeeds.
A failure publishes no partial closure, cached alias, or inferred latest revision.

publication_transaction.authority: admin plus explicit local catalog publication permission
publication_transaction.commit_rule: immutable catalog revision, entries, dependency edges, closure digest, current head, idempotency settlement, audit record, and outbox event commit atomically

restart_recovery.rule: restart reloads the immutable closure by identity and rechecks every digest before use

forbidden_behavior: live GCS, spacecraft, mission-network, or legacy-adapter lookup
file URI, host absolute path, traversal, symlink, junction, or reparse resolution
floating latest revision or digest substitution
source, expression, module, plugin, template, or callable execution
